main.title: SOME CRITICAL POINT RESULTS FOR FRECHET MANIFOLDS
main.abstract: We prove a so-called linking theorem and some of its corollaries, namely a mountain pass theorem and a three critical points theorem for Keller $ C^1$-functional on $ C^1 $- Frechet manifolds. Our approach relies on a deformation result which is not implemented by considering the negative pseudo-gradient flows. Furthermore, for mappings between Frechet manifolds we provide a set of sufficient conditions in terms of the Palais-Smale condition that indicates when a local diffeomorphism is a global one.
